2609.22566.title: Do Student LLMs Inherit OOD Robustness? Invariance-Weighted Distillation for Reliable Knowledge Transfer
2609.22566.paper_summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) aims to compress high-performance teacher LLMs into lightweight students. However, distilled students often exhibit substantial performance degradation in out-of-distribution (OOD) settings, a critical gap that remains underexplored. We identify two compounding mechanisms causing OOD performance degradation: (1) data spuriousness: students can learn spurious correlations in the distillation dataset over genuine causal relationships; and (2) teacher capability: standard KD treats all samples uniformly, ignoring whether the teacher is guided by causal features or misled by spurious shortcuts on a given sample. To address these challenges, we propose Invariance-Weighted Distillation (IWD), a theoretically grounded framework that dynamically reweights training samples using an estimate of the teacher's causal reliance derived from prediction invariance across multiple synthetic environments. IWD perturbs spurious cues while preserving core semantics, assigning higher distillation weights to samples whose teacher predictions remain invariant, indicating greater reliance on causal rather than spurious features. We theoretically show that IWD reduces the student's Spurious-to-Causal (S2C) gradient ratio compared to standard uniformly weighted KD, driving the student toward more invariant representations. Experiments on four NLP benchmarks (MNLI, SQuAD-v2, CoNLL-2003 NER, and SST-2) across two model families (DeBERTa-v3 and Qwen-2.5) demonstrate that IWD consistently outperforms strong KD baselines on OOD evaluations while maintaining competitive in-distribution (ID) performance. Specifically, IWD achieves the highest accuracy in 15 out of 16 OOD benchmarks and improves average OOD performance over standard KD by 4.34 percentage points on NLI and 14.94 percentage points on QA.
2609.22566.paper_summary_zh: 知識蒸餾（KD）旨在將高性能的教師 LLM 壓縮成輕量級的學生。<lb/>然而，蒸餾後的學生在分佈外（OOD）環境中往往表現出顯著的性能下降，這是一個尚未深入探索的關鍵差距。<lb/>我們識別出兩個導致 OOD 性能下降的複合機制：（1）數據虛假性：學生可能在蒸餾數據集中學習虛假的相關性，而非真正的因果關係；以及（2）教師能力：標準 KD 將所有樣本視為均一，忽略了教師是否受到因果特徵的指導或在特定樣本上受到虛假捷徑的誤導。<lb/>為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了不變加權蒸餾（IWD），這是一個理論基礎的框架，通過使用從多個合成環境中的預測不變性推導出的教師因果依賴估計，動態重新加權訓練樣本。<lb/>IWD 在保留核心語義的同時擾動虛假線索，並對教師預測保持不變的樣本分配更高的蒸餾權重，這表明對因果而非虛假特徵的更大依賴。<lb/>我們從理論上表明，IWD 減少了學生的虛假到因果（S2C）梯度比率，相較於標準的均勻加權 KD，推動學生朝向更不變的表示。<lb/>在兩個模型系列（DeBERTa-v3 和 Qwen-2.5）上的四個 NLP 基準（MNLI、SQuAD-v2、CoNLL-2003 NER 和 SST-2）實驗表明，IWD 在 OOD 評估中始終超越強大的 KD 基準，同時保持競爭力的內部分佈（ID）性能。<lb/>具體而言，IWD 在 16 個 OOD 基準中有 15 個達到了最高的準確率，並在 NLI 上比標準 KD 提高了 4.34 個百分點，在 QA 上提高了 14.94 個百分點的平均 OOD 性能。
